title: The Second Songbook
author: Kestrel Nakamura
blurb: Zephyrine Fairweather, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
